title: Şimdi

characters.MAN: a young man of about twenty with messy brown hair, wearing a blue hoodie
characters.GRANDPA: his grandfather, an old man with white hair and a white beard, wearing a knitted vest and glasses

scenes.prompt: {MAN} sits on a sofa staring at his phone, ignoring {GRANDPA}, who sits in an armchair beside him, holding an old photo album, cozy living room.
{MAN} puts his phone face down on the table and turns toward {GRANDPA}, warm lamp light.

scenes.text: Dedenin aynı hikâyeyi üçüncü kez anlatmasını dinle.
scenes.prompt: {GRANDPA} tells a story with lively hand gestures while {MAN} listens closely, smiling, the photo album open between them.

scenes.text: Çünkü bir gün o sesi duymak için her şeyini verirsin.
scenes.prompt: {MAN}, a few years older, sits alone in the same armchair holding the old photo album, a soft tear, autumn light from the window.

scenes.text:
Sevdiklerin şimdi burada.
Şimdi yanlarında ol.
scenes.prompt: A big family dinner table on a warm evening, {MAN} laughs with {GRANDPA} and family members, warm golden light, steaming dishes.

caption:
En değerli şey, sevdiklerimizle geçirdiğimiz zaman. 🤍

Bugün kimi arayacaksın?
